description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes related to device descriptors, including camera and Zigbee device descriptors, firmware, and versioning information.

classes.name: DeviceFirmware
classes.description: Represents firmware information including version, filenames, checksum, and type.

classes.name: DeviceVersionList
classes.description: Represents a list of device versions, which can be a list, wildcard, or range.

classes.name: DeviceDescriptor
classes.description: Main structure describing a device, including hardware, firmware, and metadata.

classes.name: CameraMotionSettings
classes.description: Settings related to camera motion detection sensitivity and region of interest.

classes.name: CameraDeviceDescriptor
classes.description: Extends DeviceDescriptor with camera-specific settings like protocol and motion settings.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorFree
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a DeviceDescriptor.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorPrint
methods.description: Logs a DeviceDescriptor to the info log.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorClone
methods.description: Creates a copy of a DeviceDescriptor.
